propositions: Plan-review and code-review gates currently make independent discovery decisions through separate registry, routing, runner, checkpoint, and failure paths, causing policy-ownership defects like disabled built-ins, omitted criteria, and incorrect checkpoint states.

Implement one shared review-discovery architecture using immutable repository-bound effective-policy snapshots with built-ins, project LLM/DET criteria, routing, budget, and applicability, with gate-owned strategies and a shared typed executor.

Project code-review LLM criteria must require non-empty repository-relative globs; migrate project.review-phase-boundaries from empty list to ['**'] without changing membership, and audit all documentation and config references.
Positive explicit usd_budget values are authoritative on both gates; omission is uncapped for code-review but preserves existing plan-review budget policy; zero is invalid and never disables.
Add rebar review-plan --retry to reuse content-identical successes and retry only missing calls with fresh budget; only the latest INDETERMINATE review with retryable missing calls is eligible.

Compute legacy and new deterministic projections from same observed calls without duplicate model calls; compare selections, order, context, model, budget, posture, usage, and checkpoint decisions; allow only approved deltas.
